title_zh: 埃隆·马斯克生平时间线

sections.content_zh: 埃隆·里夫·马斯克（Elon Reeve Musk）是当代最具影响力的企业家和创新者之一。他出生于南非，先后在加拿大和美国发展，创立了多家改变世界的公司，包括特斯拉、SpaceX、Neuralink等。他的愿景是让人类成为多行星物种，并确保人工智能的安全发展。
sections.content_en: Elon Reeve Musk is one of the most influential entrepreneurs and innovators of our time. Born in South Africa, he developed his career in Canada and the United States, founding multiple world-changing companies including Tesla, SpaceX, and Neuralink. His vision is to make humanity a multi-planetary species and ensure the safe development of artificial intelligence.

sections.content_zh: 马斯克1971年6月28日出生于南非比勒陀利亚。10岁自学编程，12岁开发Blastar游戏。1989年移居加拿大就读女王大学，后转入宾夕法尼亚大学获得物理学和经济学双学位。1995年被斯坦福大学博士项目录取但两天后即辍学创业。
sections.content_en: Musk was born on June 28, 1971, in Pretoria, South Africa. He taught himself programming at age 10 and developed the Blastar game at age 12. In 1989, he moved to Canada to attend Queen's University, then transferred to the University of Pennsylvania, earning dual degrees in Physics and Economics. In 1995, he was admitted to Stanford's PhD program but dropped out after just two days to start his entrepreneurial journey.

sections.content_zh: 1995年与弟弟创立Zip2，1999年以3.07亿美元被康柏收购。随后创立X.com，后与Confinity合并成为PayPal，2002年以15亿美元被eBay收购，马斯克获得1.65亿美元。
sections.content_en: In 1995, founded Zip2 with his brother, sold to Compaq for $307 million in 1999. Then founded X.com, which merged with Confinity to become PayPal, acquired by eBay for $1.5 billion in 2002, with Musk receiving $165 million.

sections.content_zh: 2002年6月创立SpaceX。2004年投资630万美元成为特斯拉董事长和最大股东。2008年金融危机期间两家公司濒临破产，但猎鹰1号第四次发射成功挽救了SpaceX。
sections.content_en: Founded SpaceX in June 2002. In 2004, invested $6.3 million to become Tesla's Chairman and largest shareholder. During the 2008 financial crisis, both companies were near bankruptcy, but Falcon 1's fourth launch success saved SpaceX.

sections.content_zh: 2010年特斯拉IPO筹集2.26亿美元。2006年与表亲共同创立SolarCity，2016年被特斯拉以26亿美元收购。期间经历两次婚姻。
sections.content_en: Tesla IPO in 2010 raised $226 million. Co-founded SolarCity with cousins in 2006, acquired by Tesla for $2.6 billion in 2016. Experienced two marriages during this period.

sections.content_zh: 2016年创立Neuralink和The Boring Company。2018-2021年与格莱姆斯交往并生下两个孩子。2021年与Neuralink高管希冯·齐利斯生下双胞胎。
sections.content_en: Founded Neuralink and The Boring Company in 2016. 2018-2021 relationship with Grimes produced two children. In 2021, had twins with Neuralink executive Shivon Zilis.

sections.content_zh: 2022年10月以440亿美元收购Twitter并更名为X。2023年7月创立xAI开发Grok AI。
sections.content_en: October 2022: Acquired Twitter for $44 billion and renamed it to X. July 2023: Founded xAI to develop Grok AI.

sections.content_zh: 2025年1-5月担任DOGE特别政府雇员推动联邦效率改革。2026年2月宣布SpaceX与xAI合并，估值1.25万亿美元，计划6月以STAR代码IPO。
sections.content_en: January-May 2025: Served as special government employee at DOGE pushing federal efficiency reforms. February 2026: Announced SpaceX-xAI merger valued at $1.25 trillion, planning June IPO under ticker STAR.
